I am an old woman, seventy-one years, and this small plot is what feeds me. I have no schooling, so I do what my mother showed me and what I see my neighbors doing. If the coupon comes from the government I will use the fertilizer, but my plot is very small, less than half a hectare, so even one bag is almost too much — I will spread it carefully on the maize. I keep a few chickens and I sweep their droppings with old maize stalks onto the field before the rains. My legs are tired now, so my grandchildren help me weed, and sometimes I give a neighbor boy a little maize to help with the ridging.
